title: The chimney, close
logline: The cannery chimney across the bay, drawn close for the first time in twenty-eight years — from the boat launch, the Legacy behind, the brick, the rusted ladder, the cap. Not smoking. Two years before it is.

panels.composition: A tall brick cannery chimney close from a boat launch across the water, its rusted ladder and cap, no smoke, gulls on the rim, a station wagon at the launch's edge.
